question: In April 2025, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved the development of a Greenfield High-Speed Corridor connecting which two states on NH06 under Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya and Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Greenfield High-Speed Corridor:** A **Greenfield project** refers to infrastructure development starting from scratch without the need to modify or demolish existing structures. It is vital for improving connectivity and economic growth.
 
• In **April 2025**, the **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs** approved the development of a **Greenfield High-Speed Corridor** to connect the states of **Meghalaya** and **Assam**. This project is a part of National Highway NH06.
 
• The corridor is being developed under the **Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM)**, which is a public-private partnership model where the government and private players share the risks and responsibilities for infrastructure projects. *Hence, the correct answer is Meghalaya and Assam.*
 
• **Importance of NH06:** NH06 is a crucial highway connecting the northeastern region of India, aiding in **trade, travel, and transportation**. Developing a high-speed corridor along this route will improve logistics and reduce travel time.
 
• The project is expected to enhance connectivity between **Assam's economic hubs** and **Meghalaya's tourist destinations**, boosting regional economic activities and tourism. *Hence, the importance of this development is significant.*
 
• **Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM):** Under HAM, **40%** of the total project cost is funded by the government during the construction phase, while the remaining **60%** is arranged by private developers. This reduces the financial burden on private players while ensuring accountability. *Hence, this model is efficient for infrastructure development.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Meghalaya:**

 
 
• **Location:** Meghalaya is a state in northeastern India, known for its **picturesque landscapes, waterfalls, and biodiversity**.
 
• **Tourism:** Popular tourist destinations include **Shillong, Cherrapunji**, and **Mawsynram**, which are known for their scenic beauty and heavy rainfall.
 
• **Economic Activities:** Agriculture, forestry, and tourism are key contributors to Meghalaya's economy. The development of the Greenfield High-Speed Corridor is expected to boost tourism and local industries.
 
 
 
• **Assam:**
 
 
• **Location:** Assam is another northeastern state in India, famous for its **tea plantations, silk, and vibrant culture.**
 
• **Significance:** It serves as an economic hub in the northeastern region, with **Guwahati** being a major city for trade and commerce.
 
• **Connectivity:** Assam's strategic location makes it a gateway to other northeastern states. Improved connectivity through the NH06 corridor will further strengthen this role.
 
 
 
• **Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM):**
 
 
• **Key Features:** HAM is a financial model for building infrastructure, particularly highways, where the government bears a part of the initial cost, reducing risks for private companies.
 
• **Advantages:** It ensures better risk management and efficient project execution, while also providing steady returns for private companies.
 
• **Application:** HAM has been widely implemented for infrastructure projects in India, ensuring timely completion and financial sustainability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Benefits:**

 
 
• The Greenfield High-Speed Corridor will **reduce travel time**, improve logistics, and boost economic growth by facilitating trade and tourism between **Meghalaya** and **Assam**.
 
• **Environmental Impact:** Being a Greenfield project, it is designed to minimize environmental damage by avoiding existing urban and sensitive areas.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• **National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP):** The corridor aligns with India's vision to improve infrastructure under NIP, which aims to provide world-class infrastructure and boost economic activities.
 
• **Other Projects:** Similar Greenfield projects include the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail (Bullet Train) and Bengaluru–Chennai Expressway.
 
• **Conclusion:** The development of the Greenfield High-Speed Corridor between Meghalaya and Assam is a significant step towards enhancing connectivity and promoting economic growth in the northeastern region of India.
